Others
 
 Vs.
 State of Odisha & Another ..... 
 
 Coram:
 Justice Savitri Ratho
 Order
19.05.2023 Order No. (Through hybrid mode)
1. None appears for the petitioner when the matter is called.

2. This application under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the petitioner for quashing the criminal prosecution in connection with C.T. Case No. 86 of 2020 arising out of Baisinga P.S. Case No. 145 of 2020 and cognizance of the order dated 10.02.2021 taking cognizance of the offences under Sections 363, 376(2)(n), 34 of the IPC and Sections 6 and 17 of the POCSO Act.
3. Perusal of the order sheet reveals that in spite of order dated 10.02.2022 and 15.02.2022 defects pointed out by the S.R. have not yet been removed.

4. Considering the above situation and since more than two years have elapsed since the cognizance of the offences was taken in the said case, I am not inclined to adjourn the case any further.
5. The CRLMC is accordingly dismissed for non-prosecution.
Sukanta .............................. (SAVITRI RATHO) JUDGE Designation: Senior Stenographer Reason:
